Describe the resulting behavior and why it helps.

## Release notes

Describe the user-facing change in plain language, or write None for maintenance. Use a Conventional Commit PR title; a squash merge uses that title as the release commit. Describe any breaking change and upgrade steps here.

## Validation

Record the checks performed and any remaining limits. For dev → master, review the generated version/release-note preview and test the current Narrio Dev APK on a phone. Use a merge commit to preserve feature history.
